question: What is the smallest dimension-zero object that enforces (k_D,k_M)=Lambda(c_D,c_M) without being an ordinary Pati-Salam scalar or adding carrier support?

portalLabelSpace.target: a one-dimensional invariant subspace with both D and M components nonzero

finiteSymmetryExhaustion.class: real signed-permutation involutions of the canonical two-label orthonormal basis

candidates.result: keeps both portals with equal normalized coefficients
keeps both portals with opposite normalized coefficients

finiteSymmetryExhaustion.minimality: The trivial group fixes E. A nontrivial involution is the smallest group action, and among canonical signed permutations only plus-or-minus exchange has a one-dimensional fixed space with both portal components nonzero.

weightedReflection.realCpSlice: kappa=plus-or-minus 1 if the standard metric and real basis are fixed
weightedReflection.boundary: For arbitrary kappa the desired ratio has been inserted into the generator, or equivalently into a weighted portal metric. It is not derived by Z2 alone.

u1Audit.oneZeroCharge: fixed dimension one but one portal coefficient is killed
u1Audit.realRotation: the nontrivial SO(2) rotation representation has no nonzero fixed vector
u1Audit.conjugatedRepresentation: 1 direct-sum chi can be conjugated so its invariant line is mixed, but that conjugation explicitly supplies the desired line and ratio
u1Audit.verdict: U(1) is continuous overkill and has no greater predictive content than the Z2 reflection.

realLineAudit.map: iota:R -> R^2, Lambda maps to Lambda(a,b)
realLineAudit.enforces: one common coefficient line once (a,b) is supplied
realLineAudit.normalization: a^2+b^2=1 still leaves a continuum of projective rays
realLineAudit.cpEffect: CP makes the line real but does not choose it
realLineAudit.exchangeEffect: canonical exchange reduces the allowed normalized rays to (1,plus-or-minus 1)/sqrt(2)

frobeniusAudit.automorphism: the nontrivial algebra automorphism exchanges e_D and e_M
frobeniusAudit.boundary: The Frobenius algebra alone admits every k_D e_D+k_M e_M. Restriction to its exchange-fixed subalgebra is the enforcing datum, so this is a packaging of the same Z2 rather than an independent derivation.

naturalTransformationAudit.objects: one-dimensional coefficient functors L_D and L_M
naturalTransformationAudit.component: eta_D_M is multiplication by kappa in C^times
naturalTransformationAudit.equalizer: compatible pairs of scalar endomorphisms satisfy mu_D=mu_M and form one complex line
naturalTransformationAudit.cpRestriction: kappa=plus-or-minus 1 in a real normalized basis
naturalTransformationAudit.boundary: Naturality enforces a common line only after eta is specified; eta is precisely the missing correspondence datum.

jAndCp.jCompatibility: The real exchange and signed-exchange matrices commute with coefficient conjugation. J acts on each physical portal and its conjugate while the label action is duplicated on the conjugate pair.
jAndCp.cpCompatibility: The fixed ray may be chosen real. CP permits the relative sign but does not choose between signs or fix a noncanonical magnitude ratio.
jAndCp.notAnExchangeOfPhysicalFields: The label involution acts on invariant-operator coefficients, not on the inequivalent Dirac bidoublet and Majorana singlet/triplet carrier fields.

carrierSupport.typedSupports: the Dirac and Majorana operators remain on their original disjoint finite supports
carrierSupport.physicalLiftBoundary: Lifting exchange to the carrier Hilbert space would require an intertwiner between inequivalent gauge representations; claim 1525 gives Hom_GPS=0, while claim 1521 shows an unrestricted cross-anchor carrier sewing generates M4 and is relation-sheet odd.

normalizedEmbeddingBoundary.formalResult: With the named portal basis and canonical equal metric, Z2 fixes the normalized embedding (c_D,c_M) proportional to (1,plus-or-minus 1).
normalizedEmbeddingBoundary.physicalMasses: d=Lambda c_D v_H Z_D and y=Lambda c_M v_S Z_M may still have an arbitrary ratio through vacuum expectation values, Clebsch factors, kinetic normalization and matching factors.
normalizedEmbeddingBoundary.requiredAdditionalDatum: a physically sourced portal metric/normalization and vacuum-matching identity, unless all such factors are already included in the definition of the two normalized labels

minimalityTheorem.formalConstruction: The unique smallest canonical construction is the fixed line of a Z2 exchange on the two portal labels; equivalently it is the exchange-fixed unit line of the two-point dagger-Frobenius algebra or the equalizer of a specified normalized natural isomorphism.
minimalityTheorem.whatItDerives: one coefficient parameter and equal magnitude in the canonical normalized basis

reopeningDatum: Exhibit a sourced ultraviolet Ward identity or operator duality whose action on the two normalized invariant-operator lines is the exchange Z2, whose lift commutes with gauge action, grading, J and CP without acting as a carrier intertwiner, and whose counterterms preserve the fixed line. Equivalently supply the portal metric and a radiatively stable natural isomorphism rather than merely postulating kappa.
verdict: A dimension-zero Z2 exchange is the exact smallest formal mechanism: it enforces (k_D,k_M)=Lambda(1,plus-or-minus 1), is J/CP compatible, and adds no forbidden carrier support because it acts only on operator labels. An arbitrary ray requires its ratio or metric as new input, and no sourced Pati-Salam/Jordan symmetry currently provides the physical lift.
